0.why: CVmeter.cpp:249 getVoltage() on channel 0 only; the file has no getPolyVoltage and no getChannels

2.why: CVmeter.cpp:185 getVoltage() added to the RST button's value and taken as a rising edge

3.why: CVmeter.cpp:239 getVoltage() added to the FREEZE button's value and taken as a rising edge

comment: The module has no outputs at all. The A and B jacks get no family because what they carry depends on the mode switch above each of them: a level to measure or a clock to time. The RST and FREEZE buttons are summed with their jacks before the edge is taken (CVmeter.cpp:185 and :239), so pressing a button while its jack is already high does nothing. The BPM figure in CV mode is 120 times two to the power of the voltage (:331 and :444), clamped at 999. Everything the module reports is drawn on displays with no ParamWidget of their own, so none of it can be clicked for help.
